description: Multi-instance Tableau Search MCP Server Configuration Example

environment_variables.TABLEAU_INSTANCES: JSON array of Tableau instances to search across
environment_variables.SYSTEM_PROMPT: Custom system prompt for result prioritization

example_configuration.SYSTEM_PROMPT: Prioritize results based on relevance to the user query, content freshness, and usage popularity. Production instances should be weighted higher than staging instances.

instance_configuration_schema.name: Unique identifier for the instance (required)
instance_configuration_schema.server: Tableau server URL (required, must start with https://)
instance_configuration_schema.siteName: Tableau site name (optional, empty string for default site)
instance_configuration_schema.patName: Personal Access Token name (required for pat auth)
instance_configuration_schema.patValue: Personal Access Token value (required for pat auth)
instance_configuration_schema.jwtSubClaim: JWT subject claim (required for direct-trust auth)
instance_configuration_schema.connectedAppClientId: Connected App Client ID (required for direct-trust auth)
instance_configuration_schema.connectedAppSecretId: Connected App Secret ID (required for direct-trust auth)
instance_configuration_schema.connectedAppSecretValue: Connected App Secret Value (required for direct-trust auth)
instance_configuration_schema.jwtAdditionalPayload: Additional JWT payload as JSON string (optional)
instance_configuration_schema.enabled: Whether this instance is enabled (default: true)
instance_configuration_schema.priority: Instance priority 1-10, higher numbers = higher priority (default: 5)
instance_configuration_schema.maxConcurrentRequests: Max concurrent requests to this instance (default: 10)

common_configuration.INCLUDE_TOOLS: Comma-separated list of tools to include (optional)
common_configuration.EXCLUDE_TOOLS: Comma-separated list of tools to exclude (optional)

docker.description: Docker deployment with multiple Tableau instances
docker.dockerfile:
FROM node:18-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production
COPY . .
RUN npm run build
EXPOSE 3927
CMD ["npm", "start"]
docker.docker_compose:
version: '3.8'
services:
  tableau-search-mcp:
    build: .
    ports:
      - "3927:3927"
    environment:
      - TRANSPORT=http
      - TABLEAU_INSTANCES=${TABLEAU_INSTANCES}
      - SEARCH_CACHE_TTL=300000
      - MAX_CONCURRENT_SEARCHES=15
      - SEARCH_TIMEOUT=45000
      - ENABLE_REQUEST_CACHING=true
      - DEFAULT_LOG_LEVEL=info
    restart: unless-stopped

usage_examples.basic_search: Search for all content related to 'sales performance'
usage_examples.filtered_search: Search workbooks in Finance project created after 2023-01-01
usage_examples.detailed_results: Get detailed metadata for analytics content with 50 results max
usage_examples.timeout_handling: Search with custom 60-second timeout for large instances

common_issues.no_healthy_instances: Check instance URLs, authentication credentials, and network connectivity
common_issues.authentication_failures: Verify PAT tokens or Connected App credentials are valid and not expired

monitoring.request_tracking: Each instance tracks request count and response times
monitoring.error_logging: Failed operations are logged with detailed error messages
